title: Bar Series Pineapple Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Raspberry by Bar Series is a bold fruit pairing that balances tropical tang with berry sweetness. The Pineapple flavour is bright and juicy, offering a vivid tropical edge, while the Raspberry adds a sharper, more vibrant note that deepens the blend. Together, they create a punchy fruit vape with clean, balanced flavour and a lingering sweetness on the exhale. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine uptake. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. Explore Bar Series' wide range of flavours, which includes fruit blends, confectionery, icy menthols and many more exciting profiles crafted with extra-concentrated flavour for intense taste. Bar Series e-liquids cater to all vapers by offering 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic salts designed to perform perfectly in your favourite pod kit.
